WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = m.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.link_to_major
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT maj.department,
           dc.member_count,
           1.0 * dc.member_count / SUM(dc.member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts AS dc
    JOIN major AS maj ON maj.major_id = dc.major_id
), averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
), qualifying AS (
    SELECT ds.member_count, ds.share, a.average_share
    FROM department_shares AS ds
    CROSS JOIN averages AS a
    WHERE ds.share > a.average_share
)
SELECT SUM(member_count) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM qualifying

assumptions.assumption: Departments are represented by major rows with members who have matching income records; members with no matching major are excluded, and distinct majors sharing a department are combined into one department count.
